>
[Bound Guardian](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2205)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 120 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 675 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _bound guardian_ is a [tattoo guardian](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1331) bonded to your skin, which you can temporarily animate to protect you. If your soul leaves your body, your tattoo guardian might be destroyed.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([conjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=33)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You animate your tattoo guardian, otherwise using the duration and other parameters of a 4th-level [_summon construct_](/Spells.aspx?ID=318) spell. You can have the guardian Fly Free as part of Activating your tattoo. If your tattoo guardian drops to 0 HP, the activation ends, and the inanimate tattoo returns to your skin.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
